title: Business Intelligence and Data Visualization
description: This course introduces students to the principles, tools and best practices of business intelligence and data visualization to enable the analysis of business data to improve decisions and performance. The course provides students with hands-on experience using appropriate software to create visual displays of quantitative data - in reports, graphs, charts, maps, stories and dashboards – to facilitate communication of actionable insights for managerial decision-making.
attributes: Crosslisted with: MKT 306 Distance Learning Approved
